Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dazcache 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.

  • A persistent cache shared by every R process on a machine: cache() opens a directory; cache_get(), cache_set(), cache_has(), cache_delete(), cache_mget() and cache_mset() read and write it; cache_keys(), cache_entries(), cache_count(), cache_volume() and cache_stats() describe it.

  • Keys are text, or any R value the specified key encoding covers (cache_key()), so a cache keyed on function arguments survives R upgrades.

  • Small values live in a transactional ‘libmdbx’ database through ‘mdbx’; values of inline_max bytes or more become read-only, content-addressed files, stored once however many keys hold them (cache_path()).

  • Entries expire (expire =, cache_expire()), carry tags (cache_evict(tag =)), and are evicted least-recently-stored first when the cache holds more than size_limit (cache_cull()).

  • Atomic operations across processes: cache_add(), cache_pop(), cache_touch(), cache_incr(), cache_decr() and cache_transact().

  • cache_memoise() caches a function’s results across sessions and processes; as_cachem() lets ‘memoise’ and ‘shiny’ use a cache.

  • cache_check() finds and repairs damage, and reclaims what a crash leaves.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
